notes.note: Rowell wasn't massive this week but still had the second highest score for the Suns from his 28 disposals which included an impressive 19 contested possessions and 8 clearances. He is finishing the season strong.
Rowell had a huge game in the wet in Canberra with 21 contested possessions 17 clearances and 16 tackles to go with 40 disposals. A brilliant game for the Brownlow medallist.
Rowell got to 30 disposals and 9 tackles in a solid display which included 18 contested disposals.
Rowell was the third highest scoring Sun this week with 15 contested and 9 clearances but 6 clangers and 4 free kicks against really hurt his scoring.
Rowell was huge with 11 tackles going with his 26 disposals and 7 clearances. This was just his third over 100 since the byes but he was fantastic.
Rowell had the second best score for the Suns with his 27 disposals and 16 contested possessions.
Rowell had his lowest for a few weeks with his efficiency held low at 65% and a metres gained of just 158 from his 26 disposals.
Rowell was the best of the game for the Suns with his 12 contested possessions and 6 clearances from his 22 disposals.
Rowell hasn't been a consistent scorer this season and hasn't strung two 100+ scores together since rounds 5 and 6.
Rowell looked good with his 26 disposals and 6 clearances as the main tagging attention didn't go to him this week.
Many coaches looked at Rowell this week but he wasn't able to make his modest BE. That has now risen and it would be worth waiting to see some solid form before picking him up.
Rowell was the top scorer for the Suns with 14 contested possessions and 14 clearances with 31 disposals and 7 tackles. This was more like the Brownlow form we were used to.
Rowell had 10 tackles but also his 18 disposals came at an incredibly low 38% efficiency delivering his second poor score in his four games this year.
Rowell top scored for the Suns as he and Petracca ran the midfield. 35 disposals with 17 contested possessions.
Rowell was the best for the Suns with 3 disposals 8 clearances and 17 contested possessions. He was much better than last week. No rush to get him in if that is your plan though.
Rowell returned to the team this week but it wasn't a triumphant one with just 13 disposals. The Suns did struggle but his hand may still be affecting him.
We won't see Rowell for until at least round 4 through injury.
